items.title: CISA Warns of Ubiquiti UniFi OS Vulnerability Actively Exploited in Attacks
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added multiple Ubiquiti UniFi OS vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, warning that at least one of the flaws is now being actively exploited in the wild.
